strongest_angle: NASA's Voyager team successfully stretched the diminishing power supply of Voyager 1 in September 2026 via the Big Bang operation and resolved an unexpected 48-hour communication pause on October 20, 2026.

key_facts.fact: In early September 2026, engineers completed Voyager 1's Big Bang power-saving effort by turning off three devices and substituting them with three lower-power alternatives simultaneously.
On October 20, 2026, an unexpected loss of communication with Voyager 1 resolved itself after 48 hours before the team sent commands to the spacecraft.
NASA's Voyager team successfully completed a months-long effort to conserve the diminishing power supply of the Voyager 1 spacecraft in interstellar space.

numbers.label: Devices turned off and replaced simultaneously
